candidates: When copying an existing code block (e.g., grammar rules or parser actions) as a template for new code, do not carry forward commented-out debug statements (e.g., `/* console.log(...) */`). Remove dead or disabled debugging code rather than propagating it.

Always prefer the nullish coalescing operator (`??`) over logical OR (`||`) when providing a fallback/default value. Unlike `||`, `??` only falls back on `null` or `undefined`, preventing unintended short-circuiting on falsy-but-valid values such as `0`, `false`, or empty strings.
